name: 73049 · Jones, OK
findings: ZIP 73049 (Jones) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73049 (Jones) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
